title: Release media: slate & diffshot storyboard for changelog blog and quickstart
creator: Olivia Chen
description: Create a compact, reusable image pack and storyboard for the 2026.03 changelog blog + quickstart docs. Focus is on: 1) a neutral release slate (title + three hero badges) for blog headers and social; 2) a set of ’diffshots’ showing before/after UI for two major changes (Console rollout UI and Quickstart card flows) with annotated callouts; 3) supporting micro-animations (GIF/WebP) that illustrate the new rollout toggle and the new screenshot capture modal. Deliverables must be export-ready for web and social, follow brand tokens, and include figma components for future releases.
acceptance_criteria: Slate asset: 1200x600 PNG and 1:1 1080x1080 square for socials, editable Figma component with text tokens
Diffshot set: side-by-side PNGs for Desktop and Mobile states, each with label overlays and accessible color contrast
Annotations: vector callouts exported as SVG and flattened PNGs for CMS use
Micro-animations: two 5-7s looping WebP/GIF demos, optimized under 1MB where possible
Figma: single root file with organized pages, named components, layer guidelines and export presets
Design QA: visual review sign-off from PM and Eng and one round of copy/os review incorporated
tasks: Kickoff: align on messaging with PM (PM-442) and list of feature callouts
Collect latest console screenshots from ENG environment (eng-screenshots-2026.03)
Create three slate concept thumbnails and internal polling for hero direction
Build diffshot templates (desktop/mobile) with grid, padding, and badge placements
Produce final export kit: PNG, SVG, WebP, and Figma shared components
Handoff: upload assets to Drive and attach to the changelog PR and marketing CMS
export_specs: PNG: sRGB, 8-bit, no metadata; 1200x600 for header; 1080x1080 for socials
SVG: outline fonts, minimal IDs, preserve shapes for callouts
WebP: lossless for animations where small; target <1MB; 40-60 fps capped
GIF: fallback for older CMS, 256 colors max, loop true
screenshots_required: Console - Rollouts list (with old toggle state)
Console - Rollouts list (with new single-toggle state)
Quickstart - Card with sample app created
Screenshot capture modal open (showing device selector)
